rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR INCREASED INVESTMENT TO HOUSING BY THE SOCIAL SECURITY SYSTEM BY REQUIRING THAT AT LEAST THIRTY PERCENT (30%) OF ITS INVESTMENT RESERVE FUND BE ALLOCATED TO THE PROVISION OF DIRECT HOUSING LOANS TO ITS MEMBERS, THEREBY AMENDINGSECTION 21 OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 1161, AS AMENDED, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Amends Section 26 of Republic Act No. 1161, as amended, otherwise known as the Social Security Law by requiring at least thirty (30%) per centum of the investible funds of the Social Security System (SSS) be allocated to direct housing loans to itsmembers. Provides, likewise, that investments up to ten (10%) per centum of the investible funds may be made by the SSS in the provision of the loans for the construction and maintenance of hospitals and institutions for the sick, aged and infirm. ** *
rows.status: Substituted by HB07758

rows.abstract: Imposes total commercial logging ban for a period of twenty-five (25) years from the effectivity of this Act in all timber lands in the country. Defines commercial logging as the cutting, felling or destruction of trees from all growth and residualforests for the purpose of selling or otherwise disposing to the cut or felled logs for profit. * * *
rows.status: Substituted by HB07130

Explains that the LGUs are in the best position to discover instances of hoarding, profiteering and cartels. * * *

rows.title_full: AN ACT REQUIRING ALL LOCAL WATER DISTRICTS TO SECURE THE CONFORMITY OF THE LOCAL GOVERNMENT UNITS CONCERNED BEFORE ANY INCREASE IN EXISTING WATER RATES AND CHARGES CAN BE IMPOSED BY THE FORMER, AMENDING FOR THIS PURPOSE PRESIDENTIAL DECREE NO. 198,AS AMENDED, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE PROVINCIAL WATER UTILITIES ACT OF 1973
rows.abstract: Requires all local water districts to secure the conformity of the local government units (LGUs) concerned before the said districts can impose any increase in existing water rates and charges even after these water districts have conducted public hearings relative to the said increases. * * *
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on PUBLIC WORKS AND HIGHWAYS since 1995-07-26

rows.title_full: AN ACT INTEGRATING ALL EXISTING ALLOWANCES OF THE UNIFORMED MEMBERS OF THE ARMED FORCES OF THE PHILIPPINES AND THE PHILIPPINE NATIONAL POLICE IN THEIR BASIC PAY
rows.abstract: Integrates all existing allowances of the uniformed personnel of the Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) and Philippine National Police (PNP) in their basic pay in view of computing the monthly pension of retiring personnel. Seeks to alleviate thefinancial difficulties of retiring AFP and PNP personnel and ensures that they will be receiving a larger pension by increasing the base on which the pension is computed. * * *
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on APPROPRIATIONS since 1995-07-26

rows.author: A023
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE AUTOMATIC RETENTION BY LOCAL GOVERNMENT UNITS OF THEIR RESPECTIVE INTERNAL REVENUE ALLOTMENTS ON THE THIRD YEAR OF THE EFFECTIVITY OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7160, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE LOCAL GOVERNMENT CODE OF 1991, AND THEREAFTER, AMENDING FOR THIS PURPOSE CHAPTER 1, TITLE THREE, BOOK II THEREOF, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Provides for the automatic retention by the local government units (LGUs) of their respective internal revenue and allotments (IRAs)) on the third year of the effectivity of Republic Act No. 7160, otherwise known as the Local Government Code of 1991. Allows the LGUs to automatically retain their IRAs so that they can promptly disburse much needed funds in order to timely apply them to the pertinent expenditures and purposes. * * *
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LOCAL GOVERNMENT since 1995-07-26

rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BANKS AND FINANCIAL INTERMEDIARIES since 1995-07-26

rows.abstract: Amends Republic Act No. 6846, otherwise known as the Abot-Kaya Pabahay Law, by integrating its use into the development of a long term approach to the National shelter Program, expanding the level of amortization support by providing a third and fourth level, activating the Cash Flow Guaranty component of the Fund, enhancing the NHMFC's interest shortfall subsidy and liquidity mechanism for its secondary mortgage operation to augment interest subsidy support for the Community Mortgage Program,and increasing the administrative cost ceiling from one (1%) per centum to four (4%) per centum of the net Fund Assets. * * *

Provides for a new population policy that takes into account the interrelationsh ip between and among population, resources, environemnt and sustainable development. * * *
